data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: The validation sprint runs end-to-end without manual intervention on a ≥1500 LOC, ≥3-story epic
- DD2: All mechanical proxies pass: draft PR from Phase A; readable DSO-Story trailers; reviewer-findings.json + DefenseStore writes; final-PR DefenseStore attestations covering merged stories; leakage 5-case test matrix passes

## Description
Execute `/dso:sprint` on the candidate epic identified in T1. Capture evidence for all 5 mechanical proxy checks. This task exercises existing sprint machinery — no new production code is introduced.

### Pre-conditions
- T1 complete: `VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:` present in the story's ticket comments
- T3 complete: `compute-rereviewed-loc.sh` exists and tests pass
- Environment: `enforcement.strategy=ci`, `merge.strategy=pr`, `git remote get-url origin` returns non-empty
- ci-pr mode active: Sprint Phase A must emit `MODE: ci-pr` banner

### Execution Procedure
1. Read `VALIDATION_EPIC_ID:` from the ticket comment on ea41-a8d8-ea1d-426f
2. Run `/dso:sprint <VALIDATION_EPIC_ID>` — allow to run to completion without manual intervention
3. Capture evidence for each mechanical proxy check after sprint completes:

#### Proxy A: Draft PR from Phase A
```bash
PROXY_A=$(gh pr list --state open --json headRefName,isDraft --jq '.[] | select(.isDraft == true) | .headRefName' | head -1)
```
Record the PR number and draft status.

#### Proxy B: DSO-Story trailers readable
```bash
# For each story merge commit on session branch:
git log --merges --format='%H' origin/main..HEAD | while read sha; do
  git interpret-trailers --parse "$sha" | grep -q '^DSO-Story:' && echo "PASS: $sha" || echo "FAIL: $sha missing trailer"
done
```

#### Proxy C: reviewer-findings.json and DefenseStore writes per story
```bash
# Check each story-branch CI run produced reviewer-findings.json:
# (inspect CI artifacts or local session-dir)
for story_dir in .sprint-artifacts/stories/*/; do
  test -f "$story_dir/reviewer-findings.json" && echo "PASS: $story_dir" || echo "FAIL: $story_dir missing"
done
```

#### Proxy D: Final-PR DefenseStore attestations cover all merged stories
```bash
# Query DefenseStore for the PR after ready-for-review transition:
# Verify each merged story's SHA range returns attestations
```

#### Proxy E: Leakage 5-case test matrix
```bash
bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-leakage-detector.sh
```
(If test file does not exist yet, document that leakage tests are pending from story 6080-8cce-25d9-4bc6 and note this as a finding in the report.)

### Evidence Recording
Capture all proxy check results in a structured file:
```
<session-dir>/proxy-check-results.md
```
Format: checkbox list with PASS/FAIL/PENDING for each proxy, with command output excerpts.

## File Impact
- `.sprint-artifacts/` (sprint creates at runtime — read-only for this task)
- `<session-dir>/proxy-check-results.md` (create — sprint run artifact)

## Integration Test Coverage
This task IS the integration test — it exercises the full sprint pipeline end-to-end. No separate integration test task is needed (exemption: the sprint run itself constitutes the boundary interaction test for Phase A through Phase I).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sprint completes without manual intervention (no STATUS:blocked emitted during run)
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && test -f "$REPO/.sprint-active" && echo "sprint still running" || echo "sprint completed"
- [ ] Phase A emits MODE: ci-pr banner (captured in sprint log)
  Verify: grep -q 'MODE: ci-pr' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-artifacts/sprint.log 2>/dev/null || echo "check sprint log for MODE: ci-pr banner"
- [ ] At least one draft PR exists from Phase A
  Verify: gh pr list --state open --json isDraft --jq '[.[] | select(.isDraft == true)] | length' | awk '{exit ($1 < 1)}'
- [ ] All story merge commits on session branch have DSO-Story trailers
  Verify: git log --merges --format='%H' origin/main..HEAD | while read sha; do git interpret-trailers --parse "$sha" | grep -q '^DSO-Story:'; done && echo "all trailers present"
- [ ] proxy-check-results.md created with all 5 proxy outcomes documented
  Verify: find $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) -name 'proxy-check-results.md' -newer $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG | grep -q .
- [ ] ≥3 stories completed in the sprint (confirming ≥3-story requirement)
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && git log --merges --format='%s' origin/main..HEAD | grep -c 'DSO-Story:' | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Run validation sprint end-to-end on candidate epic and capture mechanical proxies
